name: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd
title: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd - 543278 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue up 66% to INR10,275 crores and PAT up 118% to INR410 crores, with India PBT margin held at 5.5-5.6% and non-GML debt heading to zero in FY27.

triggers.label: Q4 consolidated revenue up 66%
triggers.quote: consolidated revenue and PAT growth for the quarter have b een 66% and 118%, respectively

triggers.label: Non-GML India debt to zero in FY27
triggers.quote: we want to make it a non -GML debt-free in the running financial year

triggers.label: Silver and platinum gains non-recurring
triggers.quote: there has been some advantage because of the platinum and silver margin, which again cannot be sustained for the next financial year

triggers.label: Gold up 60-70% constrains volume
triggers.quote: Customer does not have the money to spend 70% more than what he budgeted.

guidance.value: 150 across Kalyan, Candere and regional brand
guidance.quote: we plan to open 150 showrooms across Kalyan, Candere and the new regional brand

guidance.value: in the range of 5.5% - 5.6%, maybe some improvement
guidance.quote: the PBT India has been in the range of, what, 5.5% - 5.6%. I think that is here to stay.

guidance.value: zero in FY27, possibly by H1
guidance.quote: we want to make it a non -GML debt-free in the running financial year
I would say about INR30 crores will be reduced from this number.

prior_guidance_check.quote: The year also saw a reduction of debt in India by INR360-odd crores, in line with the already announced plan to pay down the non-GML debt in India completely.

red_flags.label: Gross margin tailwind from silver/platinum non-recurring
red_flags.quote: there has been some advantage because of the platinum and silver margin, which again cannot be sustained for the next financial year

red_flags.label: Promoter pledge unchanged
red_flags.quote: there is no change for the past, 15 months

red_flags.label: Q3 Diwali coin demand abnormal
red_flags.quote: Q3FY26 was a bit abnormal, especially during the Diwali time.

evasions.quote: I'm not able to guide you clearly whether there can be a loss of revenue in this quarter

evasions.topic: Middle East FOCO conversion cash flow
evasions.quote: I don't want any budgeting from, the project which we are trying to plan.
